verdict.rationale: Navan publishes a developer portal documenting a public API with OAuth 2.0 client-credentials auth. It offers retrieval and update endpoints for card transactions, expenses, reimbursements, custom fields, receipts, async job polling and webhooks, and a probe confirms an AI-oriented llms.txt on the developer site. The documented surface centers on expense data, so driving the travel side is not shown. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for travel booking and trip management, depth of reference docs (endpoint specs, rate limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
